identity.title: PHANGS-JWST First Results: Variations in PAH Fraction as a Function of ISM Phase and Metallicity

paper_type_evidence.quote: We use $^{12}{\rm CO}~(2-1)$“broad” moment 0 maps and corresponding error maps from the PHANGS-ALMA survey combining ${\rm 12m+7m+Total~Power}$
The data used in this paper are part of the PHANGS-JWST Treasury program #2107

question.value: How does the PAH fraction, traced by (F770W+F1130W)/F2100W, vary with ISM phase, galactic environment, radius and metallicity in four nearby galaxies?

evidence.quote: In this Letter, we investigate the variations of the PAH fraction traced by a combination of JWST/MIRI filters across the full disk of four nearby galaxies, IC 5332, NGC 628, NGC 1365, and NGC 7496.

We use $^{12}{\rm CO}~(2-1)$“broad” moment 0 maps
from the PHANGS-ALMA survey combining ${\rm 12m+7m+Total~Power}$
to trace molecular gas, at $\sim 1''$ ($\sim 40 - 90$ pc in our sample) resolution
“broad” moment 0 maps and corresponding error maps from the PHANGS-ALMA survey
We use MIRI (cite: rieke2015) observations in the F770W, F1130W, and F2100W filters
We use H$\alpha$ maps from the PHANGS-MUSE survey (cite: PHANGSMUSE2022Survey) to trace ionized gas.
We use Hi measurements from MeerKAT (C. Eibensteiner et al., in prep), at $15''$ resolution for NGC 7496
and from THINGS (cite: Walter2008) for NGC 628 ($\sim 11''$ for the ‘natural’ weighted map)
The background removal is done by anchoring the JWST data with *Spitzer*
To trace the ${\rm 12+log(O/H)}$ metallicity in our targets, we use the 2D maps by (cite: Williams2022).

evidence.loc: Variation of PAH fraction with ISM environment
evidence.quote: We use their spatial mask to separate pixels in 5 different categories (see their Table 1).
The white contours show the brightest H II regions (cite: GROVES_HIICAT; PHANGSMUSE2022HII).
we use a constant CO-to-H$_2$ conversion factor $\alpha_{\rm CO} = 4.35$ M$_\odot$ pc$^{-2}$ (K km s$^{-1})^{-1}$ as recommended for solar metallicity, star-forming galaxies (cite: Bolatto2013)
a $^{12}\mathrm{CO}(2-1)/^{12}\mathrm{CO}(1-0)$ line ratio $R_{21} = 0.65$ (cite: denBrok2021; Leroy2022)

smoothing.value: all maps convolved to 1'' resolution, reprojected to MIRI ~0.11'' grid

evidence.quote: We convolve all three filter maps to $1''$ resolution
We reproject these maps to the MIRI pixel grid, with pixel size $\sim 0.11''$.

what.value: MIRI data reduction and noise/background handling

evidence.quote: (cite: LEE_PHANGSJWST) give details of the reduction of the data, including noise.

what.value: CO moment-0 map processing via PHANGS-ALMA pipeline

evidence.quote: from the PHANGS-ALMA survey combining ${\rm 12m+7m+Total~Power}$ (cite: PHANGSALMA2021Pipeline; PHANGSALMA2021Survey)
and the method described in (cite: Aniano2011)

what.value: HI conversion to surface density including helium

evidence.quote: using the prescription from (cite: Leroy2012)

method.value: Convolve MIRI, CO, Hα, metallicity maps to 1'' with WebbPSF-based kernels; reproject to MIRI grid

evidence.quote: The convolution kernels were computed using the theoretical PSFs of each filter provided by the WEBBPSF (cite: WebbPSF), and the method described in (cite: Aniano2011).
We convolve all three filter maps to $1''$ resolution

analysis_steps.goal: Mask low S/N and AGN pixels

method.value: Remove pixels with S/N ≤ 3 in any MIRI band; mask AGN with F2100W PSF and by hand

evidence.quote: We remove pixels with signal-to-noise ${\rm S/N \leq 3}$ in all MIRI bands, with background noise values of 0.05, 0.05, and 0.1 MJy sr$^{-1}$.

assumptions.value: NGC 7496 noise applies to all galaxies

evidence.quote: We find that MIRI maps have similar noise, and we assume NGC 7496 estimates throughout the sample.

method.value: CO(2-1) to Σ_H2 with alpha_CO and R21; HI to Σ_HI; flat Σ_HI where no HI maps

evidence.quote: we assume that the atomic gas has a flat distribution with ${\rm \Sigma_{H{\sc I}} = 8~M_\odot~pc^{-2}}$ (including helium)
line ratio $R_{21} = 0.65$ (cite: denBrok2021; Leroy2022)
assuming optically thin 21 cm emission

analysis_steps.goal: Compute R_PAH and compare with environment

method.value: R_PAH=(F770W+F1130W)/F2100W; radial, metallicity, I_Hα/Σgas, molecular fraction and environment-mask profiles with 3×SEM error bars

evidence.quote: In all panels, the error bars are 3 times the standard error of the mean (SEM).
We assume the F2100W filter is free from contribution from PAHs and is instead dominated by small, hot dust grains
The PHANGS-JWST team used the STScI Calibration pipeline 1.7.1 for NIRCam and 1.7.0 for MIRI

used_for.value: PSFs for convolution kernels and AGN masking

evidence.quote: This is done using the WEBBPSF package (cite: WebbPSF), and centering the F2100W PSF on the central coordinates of each target.
We find average $R{\rm_{PAH} = (F770W+F1130W)/F2100W}$ values of 3.3, 4.7, 5.1, and 3.6 in IC 5332, NGC 628, NGC 1365, and NGC 7496, respectively.

results_numeric.quantity: I_Hα/Σ_HI+H2 threshold for PAH fraction decrease

evidence.quote: find that the PAH fraction decreases above a value of ${\rm I_{H\alpha}/\Sigma_{H{\sc I}+H_2}}~\sim~10^{37.5}~{\rm erg~s^{-1}~kpc^{-2}~(M_\odot~pc^{-2}})^{-1}$, in all four galaxies

findings_qualitative.value: HII regions show systematically low PAH fraction

evidence.quote: We find that H II regions traced by MUSE H$\alpha$ show a systematically low PAH fraction.

findings_qualitative.value: R_PAH weakly sensitive to molecular fraction

evidence.loc: Variation of PAH fraction with ISM environment
evidence.quote: This could suggest that the abundance of PAHs is not particularly sensitive to the molecular fraction, compared to the ionized gas content.

findings_qualitative.value: R_PAH highest in bar and interarm regions

evidence.loc: Variation of PAH fraction with ISM environment
evidence.quote: Here, we can see that $R_{\rm PAH}$ is the highest in the bar, and interarm regions, with lower values in the spiral arms, followed by the center and finally in the disk.

claims.hypothesis: PAHs are destroyed in ionized-gas dominated regions
claims.experiment: R_PAH vs I_Hα/Σ_HI+H2 binned per galaxy
claims.result: flat until ~10^37.5 then steep decline in all four galaxies
claims.finding: PAH destruction in ionized gas operates similarly across targets

evidence.quote: Our results suggest that the process of PAH destruction in ionized gas operates similarly across the four targets.

claims.experiment: Radial and metallicity profiles; 2D histograms colored by metallicity
claims.result: R_PAH decreases with radius; inter-galaxy offsets track average metallicity but no local gradient
claims.finding: global metallicity, not local variations, sets offset

evidence.loc: Variation of PAH fraction with ISM environment
evidence.quote: This implies that while the average metallicity of each galaxy seems to influence the PAH fraction, the moderate local metallicity variations are not having a large effect on $R_{\rm PAH}$.

claims.hypothesis: PAH fraction correlates with molecular gas fraction (CO)
claims.experiment: R_PAH vs molecular-to-total gas fraction from PHANGS-ALMA CO
claims.finding: PAH abundance not particularly sensitive to molecular fraction

evidence.quote: The variations with the fraction of molecular gas (Figure [2](#FigMediansPanel), bottom right panel) are rather small.

why_this_data.value: 1'' chosen to boost F2100W S/N and match CO/Hα resolution

evidence.quote: We choose to slightly degrade the data to increase the signal-to-noise (S/N) in the F2100W band. By doing so, we are also able to match the resolution of the CO and H$\alpha$ data

why_this_method.value: F770W+F1130W over F2100W improves on Spitzer 8/24 μm PAH tracer and removes radiation field dependence

evidence.quote: As both the PAH features and the 21 $\mu$m continuum are from stochastic heating, using these fluxes to determine the PAH fraction removes any significant dependence on the radiation field (cite: DL2007).

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Voronoi binning deferred to future work

evidence.loc: Variation of PAH fraction with ISM environment
evidence.quote: It will also be possible to test a Voronoï binning, to check whether the trends seen in Figure [2](#FigMediansPanel) would be significantly pulled down by taking into account more low-S/N pixels.

limitations_admitted.value: No resolved HI for IC 5332 and NGC 1365; universal threshold left to future

evidence.loc: Variation of PAH fraction with ISM environment
evidence.quote: there are (currently) no similar resolution Hi data for IC 5332 and NGC 1365, and therefore a universal threshold across all environments is left for future studies

evidence.loc: Variation of PAH fraction with ISM environment
evidence.quote: although it should be noted that the sample included in this work covers a small range of metallicity
it is as of yet uncertain how the presence of an AGN may be related to this decrease

referee_caveats_inferred: Threshold of 10^37.5 is by eye, no fit or uncertainty
HI resolution (11-15'') much coarser than 1'' analysis; flat HI assumption for two galaxies
S/N>3 cut in F2100W may bias trends toward bright regions

data_public_as_stated.value: MIRI data from MAST; ALMA project codes listed

evidence.quote: Some/all of the data presented in this paper were obtained from the Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes (MAST)

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Small: a few GB of public moment-0, MIRI, MUSE and HI image products for four galaxies
reproducibility.score_reason: Simple ratio maps from public products, but binning, masks and unpublished HI data are not fully specified
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Main ALMA role is ancillary; key threshold is qualitative and MeerKAT HI is unpublished
